services.name: Sunset Tiki Cruise
services.desc: Destin sunsets are something you don’t want to miss! About Cruise into the sunset aboard our Custom 21’ Tiki boats. Watch the setting sun from Crab Island or while cruising our beautiful harbor. Whichever you chose, our captains will make sure you have an unforgettable time. See booking details for bare-boat charter information below Booking Details: Tiki Boat tours are available from the beginning of April through the end of September. 10 Passenger Capacity Inclusions USCG Certified Life Vests Anchor Room For Coolers Exclusions Captain Fee Gratuity Additional Information It is recommended to Ages 21+ to Rent • 2 Hours • Up to 10 People

services.name: Tiki Boat Firework Cruise
services.desc: Every Thursday between Memorial Day and Labor Day there is a Destin Warbirds Airshow! Just prior to the sunset, and Destin fireworks immediately following the sunset! Dockside's owner is one of the pilots during the airshow! What a night of entertainment! Available only on Thursdays, Memorial day through Labor day. Available on July 4th also. Highlights Exciting WWII vintage airshow and fireworks display. Very comfortable and rides smooth. Easy Ride & Great Price. Fun For the Entire Family. Inclusions USCG Certified Life Vests Anchor Room For Coolers Exclusions Captain Fee Gratuity Additional 3 Hours • Up to 10 People

services.name: 12 Passenger Standard Pontoon Rental
services.desc: There is no better way to explore our beautiful Destin waters than to rent a boat for a day! About Here at Dockside Watersports, a pontoon boat is the most popular for many reasons. The adventures are never ending when you are your own captain- your family can park on a beach and snorkel, anchor at Crab Island to swim and relax all day, cruise around the bay while Dolphin watching, take it out during our one-of-a-kind sunset or cap your Thursday night off by being right underneath the T-6 Destin Warbirds airshow followed by Fireworks (call for more information)! Highlights Best way to get to Ages 21+ to Rent • 4 and 8 Hours • 23ft. • 90HP • Up to 12 People
